test.create_query: CREATE TABLE two_level_bucket_merge (a UInt32, b UInt64, c FixedString(8), d UInt32) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO two_level_bucket_merge SELECT number % 20000000, number % 20000000, toFixedString(toString(number % 100), 8), number % 4 FROM numbers_mt(50000000)
test.query: SELECT a, b, count() FROM two_level_bucket_merge GROUP BY a, b FORMAT Null
SELECT a, b, c, count() FROM two_level_bucket_merge GROUP BY a, b, c FORMAT Null
SELECT a, b, c, d, count() FROM two_level_bucket_merge GROUP BY a, b, c, d FORMAT Null
SELECT a, b, c, d, count() FROM two_level_bucket_merge GROUP BY a, b, c, d FORMAT Null SETTINGS enable_adaptive_aggregator = 0
